explain_task.question: In the revised model, explain precisely why the optimal plan drops the year-1 special investment while still using the year-2 and year-3 special channels, and why you cannot infer the same conclusion by linearly extrapolating LP shadow prices to the integer-fee model. Your answer must trace the year-1 channel from the business term “fixed management fee” to the exact CSV parameter names and values, then to the code variables `b1` and `y_b1`, the unnamed big-M constraint `b1 <= inv_limit_y1 * y_b1` (reported as `_C1`), and the objective term `- fee_y1 * y_b1`; compare this with the original model’s use of `b1` and quantify how these exact code additions produce the objective drop from 580000.0 to 553400.0. Also use the LP-relaxation diagnostics to identify which constraints are binding and state the economic meaning of the dual values for `Year1_budget` and `_C1`, including why the fractional `y_b1 = 0.8888888888888887` makes naive marginal-value extrapolation invalid for the final MIP solution.
